author: The Infographics Show
description:
How did Nazi Germany go from dominating Europe to dragging jet fighters across airfields with farm animals?

By 1944, the Nazi war machine was collapsing from the inside. Allied bombing had devastated Germany’s synthetic fuel industry, leaving advanced aircraft, tanks, and military vehicles without enough fuel to operate. At the same time, the Red Army was tearing through the Eastern Front, Western Allied forces were pushing into Germany, and critical industrial regions were being lost one after another. Germany still possessed some of the most advanced weapons of World War II. The Me 262 became the world’s first operational jet fighter. The V-2 rocket reached speeds and altitudes that Allied defenses could barely comprehend. Tanks like the Panther were terrifying when they worked.

title: How Nazi Regime Finally Collapsed
